message.content: The pain is in the upper left part of my belly, under the ribs on that side. I'm not sure if it goes anywhere, it wasn't mentioned that it spreads to my back or shoulder. It started mild about eight days ago and has gradually gotten worse. They treated it as a stomach bug (gastroenteritis) but it didn't get better, and now I'm also feeling sick and vomiting. I don't have a number for how bad it is, and I haven't noticed whether it's linked to meals or fatty food. I don't drink alcohol.
